verses.text: There are mines where silver is found, and places where gold is refined.
Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is melted out of rock.
Miners bring light into the darkness. They search the deepest places for stones hidden in the dark.
They dig shafts far from where people live, in places no one walks. They hang far from other people and swing back and forth on ropes.
Food grows from the surface of the earth, but underneath it is turned over as if by fire.
Sapphires are found in its rocks, and its dust contains gold.
No bird of prey knows that hidden path. No falcon's eye has seen it.
No proud wild animal has walked on it. No lion has gone that way.
Miners attack the hardest rock and dig away the roots of mountains.
They cut tunnels through the rock, and their eyes see all its treasures.
They dam up the sources of rivers and bring hidden things into the light.
But where can wisdom be found? Where does understanding live?
No human knows its value. It cannot be found in the land of the living.
The deep ocean says, 'It is not in me.' The sea says, 'It is not with me.'
It cannot be bought with the finest gold. Its price cannot be paid in silver.
It cannot be bought with gold from Ophir, with valuable onyx, or with sapphires.
Gold and crystal cannot compare with it. It cannot be traded for jewels of gold.
Coral and jasper are not worth mentioning. The price of wisdom is higher than rubies.
The topaz of Ethiopia cannot compare with it. It cannot be bought with pure gold.
So where does wisdom come from? Where does understanding live?
It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing, even from the birds of the sky.
Destruction and Death say, 'We have only heard rumors about it.'
God understands the way to it. He alone knows where it lives.
He sees to the ends of the earth and everything under the heavens.
When he gave the wind its force and measured out the waters,
when he made a law for the rain and a path for the thunderstorm,
then he looked at wisdom and told about it. He set it up and tested it.
And he said to people, 'Look, respecting the Lord is wisdom, and staying away from evil is understanding.'"
